jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer: English + Czech + Polish OR Lituanian
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.

- Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns.
- Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved.
- Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance.
- Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure.
- Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support.
- Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences.

- You speak and write fluently in English + Czech, and Lithuanian and/or Polish
- You are service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations.
- Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts.
- You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed.
- Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends.
- A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset.
- Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

In our kitchen, we whip up comfort-food classics that would make any grandmother beam with pride, just on an industrial scale, in heroic quantities, and with the same love for great taste!

Are you looking for a job in the food industry? Do cold temperatures not deter you?

We are looking for a production worker for a company in Aalter that specializes in meat! 

Department KITCHEN: 2-shift system

This company prioritizes hygiene and efficiency above all! 

They are looking for someone who knows how to work with meat and is not afraid to show their worth! 

What do we expect from you?

• Busy periods do not affect the quality of your work; you can handle stress well.
• You strive to deliver a top-quality product.
• Experience in a production environment is a plus.
• You speak Dutch or English.
• You are not afraid of physical work. 
• You are a team player.

Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or the perfectly cooked roast beef: dishes that make your mouth water. In this role, you help make sure others can enjoy them too. In our kitchen, we produce preparations that would make grandmothers jealous, but on an industrial scale and in large quantities.

We are looking for a Cook in the Aalter region! 
What are your responsibilities? 
• Hygiene is essential for any kitchen employee. That is why you ensure every day that your working methods and finished products comply with all applicable standards.
• You strictly follow all safety regulations. You do everything possible to guarantee both quality and safety. 

Who are you?
• You have experience as a cook in a large-scale catering kitchen or an industrial kitchen. Experience in a production environment is a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system. 
• The early shift starts at 4:30 AM and ends at 12:30 PM.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 PM and ends at 8:00 PM. 
• Team player – You are friendly, enthusiastic, and enjoy working with others. Helping colleagues comes naturally to you.
• Hands-on – You are proactive, enjoy rolling up your sleeves, and have strong practical insight.
• Flexible – You like working as part of a team but can also work independently. In addition, you enjoy the variety of working with different products and tasks.

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You are a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

If you don't meet every requirement but have some warehouse experience and a strong work ethic, you can still apply!

 

IMPORTANT: this job is only available for people who:

• Already live in Belgium
• Have a valid Belgian address
• Have legal permission to work in Belgium
Housing, relocation and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.

Our partner is part of an international company operating in the retail industry. To strengthen their Sales Support team, they are looking for a German-speaking Sales Support Specialist to assist both Account Managers and customers throughout their projects.

You will join a dynamic and sustainable work environment where growth, collaboration, and respect are at the heart of the company culture. Thanks to a structured onboarding program, you will quickly get up to speed and become a valued member of the team from day one.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do?

• You will work closely with our distributor network & managing projects.
• You will advise customers on the best solutions.
• Throughout each project, you will build and maintain strong commercial relationships with your customers.
• You will manage the entire order process, from design and quotation through to production, delivery, and after-sales follow-up.
• You will communicate daily with customers and suppliers to ensure orders are completed accurately and on time.
• You will handle customer complaints professionally by investigating issues and implementing appropriate solutions, working closely with the Account Manager when needed.
• You will monitor backorders and process product returns accurately and efficiently.
• You will ensure accurate invoicing, prepare credit notes, and follow up on outstanding payments.

We are looking for a commercially driven professional who:

• Has a strong customer focus and is passionate about delivering excellent service.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys learning new skills.
• Takes initiative and enjoys working on a variety of projects.
• Is organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities efficiently.
• Has a positive attitude and enjoys collaborating as part of a team.
• Has a hands-on mindset with strong problem-solving skills.
• Is fluent in German and English, knowledge of Dutch is a strong advantage.
• Is proficient in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

The hiring organisation is a well-established European association representing companies across a specialised industrial sector. It plays a central role in supporting its members through major green, digital, and regulatory transformations, working closely with EU institutions, businesses, and expert groups. The association leads strategic initiatives, facilitates knowledge exchange, and supports long-term industry competitiveness and sustainability.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide day-to-day support to the team manager.
• Track selected policy topics and assist in preparing brief inputs.
• Organise physical and virtual meetings, including agendas and follow-up.
• Handle travel planning and event logistics.
• Coordinate activities of working groups.
• Draft short reports and communication summaries.
• Update webpages, newsletters, and social media posts.
• Maintain contact lists, files, and member resources.

•  Degree in Office Management or similar,
• Relevant assistant experience is a must.
• Strong communication skills in English; other languages are a big plus.
• Confident with digital tools, websites, and social media.
• Skilled in Microsoft Office and collaborative platforms.
• Highly organised with strong prioritisation abilities.
• Comfortable interacting with diverse stakeholders.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently.
• Calm and reliable under time pressure.

jobs.occupation: Commercial Coordinator for the Beer Sector
jobs.description:
Our client is a main beer actor in the Belgian industry.

They have a history of knowledge and expertise and are located in Flemish Brabant.

Jobomschrijving

As a Commercial Coordinator your responsibilities are very varied but with as a main goal to optimize all commercial, logistics and sales support processes in the company.Concretely you will:

• You work closely with Sales Support, Customer Service, Finance, Marketing, and Supply Chain to ensure efficient commercial operations
• You support and optimize all ongoing commercial processes and give insights on how to make the collaboration between sales, sales support and logistics more efficient
• You analyze commercial figures, market tendencies, promotions to increase commercial insights
• You analyze demand planning processes, market tendencies in the sector to make sure the forecasts are more accurate
• You support sales, sales support, customer service and logistics teams in using the CRM tool well
• You guarantee a flawless and efficient OTC process

The Commercial Coordinator should have:

• Fluent Dutch, French and English
• Analytical insights
• Able to understand different businesses and how an entire Order To Cash process works
• Good communication and influencing skills

jobs.occupation: g2 Recruitment Solutions - Guidewire Implementation Product Owner + Business Analyst
jobs.description:
For a major insurance transformation program (Brussels Region), we are looking for an experienced freelance Product Owner with Guidewire experience to join a greenfield Guidewire Cloud implementation within Commercial Insurance.

The Product Owner will take ownership of PolicyCenter and Product Definition, working closely with business stakeholders, Business Analysts, configuration developers and other members of a distributed Agile delivery team.
Key responsibilities

• Take Product Ownership for Guidewire PolicyCenter / Product Definition

• Define and prioritise business and functional requirements

• Build, maintain and prioritise the product backlog

• Translate requirements into clear user stories together with the Business Analysts

• Drive scope and priorities throughout the different delivery phases

• Contribute to solution design and ensure alignment between business and technical teams

• Provide direction and partial leadership to the Scrum team

• Work closely with 3 - 4 Business Analysts and Guidewire configuration developers

• Coordinate with stakeholders and project team members across multiple locations

• Support the upcoming inception phase and subsequent build and delivery activities

Project context

• Greenfield Guidewire Cloud implementation

• Focus on Commercial Insurance

• PolicyCenter and Product Definition at the core of the role

• Scrum team of approximately 10 people, including 3-4 Business Analysts and configuration developers

• International/distributed project environment

• First release currently moving into User Acceptance Testing

• Next release starts with an inception phase covering requirements, solution design and user-story backlog creation

• Earlier onboarding preferred to build project and policy knowledge ahead of the next major delivery phase

Terms:

• Freelance / Long-term

• Hybrid - Europe

• Occasional on-site travel

• Start: Before the end of 2026

• English-speaking

• Strong experience as a Product Owner within complex IT transformation programs

• Previous Guidewire experience, with PolicyCenter being particularly relevant

• Good understanding of insurance policy and product processes

• Strong experience with backlog management, requirements, prioritisation and user stories

• Insurance experience; Non-Life/ P&C experience is highly relevant

• Commercial Insurance experience is an advantage but not a strict requirement

• Strong Agile/Scrum experience

• Able to bridge business, functional and technical stakeholders

• Comfortable providing direction to a multidisciplinary and distributed Scrum team

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Professional working English

jobs.occupation: Experienced Vehicle Technician Wanted – Automotive Maintenance Specialist Rumst
jobs.description:
As a vehicle technician, you are responsible for the maintenance and repair of passenger cars and light commercial vehicles of all makes. You will work in a spacious, modern body shop known for its craftsmanship and customer focus. The workshop specializes in both conventional and electric/hybrid vehicles, so you'll work with the latest automotive technologies.

On a typical day, you’ll independently carry out both minor and major maintenance services. You diagnose technical issues using state-of-the-art diagnostic tools and perform mechanical, electrical, and electronic repairs. Quality is key, and you ensure every vehicle leaves the workshop in top condition.

Are you a precise, self-reliant technician with a passion for cars? Apply now and become part of a dedicated team. Together, you’ll ensure satisfied customers and vehicles in perfect working order.

• Diploma in automotive technology at secondary education level or equivalent through experience

• At least 1 to 2 years of relevant experience as a car technician

• Knowledge of modern diagnostic tools and systems

• Able to work independently and accurately

• Proficient in English, both spoken and written

• Holder of a valid category B driver’s license

• Passion for vehicles and new technologies

jobs.occupation: Weekend Production Operator – Flexible Schedule, Attractive Pay, and Career Growth
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a rewarding and well-paid temporary opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a modern production environment? As a Weekend Production Operator, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth and efficient operations for a well-respected company in Kaulille. This temporary role runs from July through September and is ideal for individuals who are available and motivated to work long weekend shifts.

Your typical day involves operating and monitoring state-of-the-art machines, conducting quality checks, and maintaining strict hygiene and safety standards. You'll rotate between day and night shifts: one week you'll work from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and the following week from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. You will also be responsible for cleaning equipment, applying HACCP procedures, and stepping in wherever needed on the production floor to support your team.

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and you're looking to boost your income over the summer, this is the role for you. Apply now to join a team where your reliability and technical insight are valued, and where there’s potential for a long-term position based on your performance!

• Commitment to work weekends for the full 3-month period (July–September)
• Availability for both day (6:00 AM–6:00 PM) and night (6:00 PM–6:00 AM) shifts on a rotating basis
• Good command of English or Dutch
• Technical insight or an affinity for technical work
• Ability to work accurately, hygienically, and safely
• Suitable for candidates not in full-time weekday employment

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

What will you have to do?
 

 
• Learn how to prepare our extensive range of chocolates
 
• You’ll learn the recipes so you can perform all tasks independently
 
• You’ll keep your workstation tidy, because that’s how you prefer to work
 
• As a line operator, you’ll set up the machine according to the correct parameters and adjust them as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply the raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Converting machines is also part of your responsibilities, as is cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You have a degree as a chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef OR possess the necessary experience
 
• Recent graduates in the fields of chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef are also welcome
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:00 AM–1:00 PM / 1:00 PM–9:00 PM)
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are willing to undergo in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude
 
• You are a team player
